description.zh: 盯着你的 VRChat 好友：谁上线、谁下线、谁换了世界，都会第一时间发到你的 QQ。自带网页面板，账号密码等敏感信息加密保存。
description.en: Watches your VRChat friends and tells you the moment one comes online, goes offline or changes world — pushed straight to QQ. Comes with a web panel, and keeps passwords and cookies encrypted.

description.zh: 把整个程序拼起来，并负责开机和关机：读配置、连数据库、拉起监控和 QQ 机器人、开网页服务。
description.en: Puts the whole program together and handles start-up and shut-down: reads settings, opens the database, starts monitoring, the QQ bot and the web server.

description.zh: 收集程序需要的各种设置：环境变量、网页访问令牌，以及监控用到的时间参数。
description.en: Collects the settings the program needs: environment variables, the web access token, and the timing values monitoring relies on.

description.zh: 从环境变量里读配置，没填就用默认值。
description.en: Reads settings from environment variables, falling back to defaults when a value is unset.

description.zh: 读取环境变量，空串回落默认值。
description.en: Read an environment variable, falling back when empty.

description.zh: 读取整数环境变量。
description.en: Read an integer environment variable.

description.zh: 把默认值和环境变量合并成一份实际生效的配置。
description.en: Merges defaults with environment variables into the settings actually in effect.

description.zh: 合并默认值与环境变量，产出运行时参数。
description.en: Merge defaults and environment into runtime parameters.

description.zh: 决定网页访问令牌：优先用环境变量或已保存的，都没有就新生成一个并记住。
description.en: Decides the web access token: reuse the one from the environment or from storage, otherwise generate a new one and remember it.

description.zh: 解析或生成访问令牌，并迁移旧 token.txt。
description.en: Resolve or generate the access token and migrate legacy token.txt.

description.zh: 一个只负责发网页文件的小服务，用来把面板单独部署到别的地方。
description.en: A tiny server that only serves the web page files, so the panel can be hosted somewhere else.

description.zh: 创建托管 public/ 的静态服务器。
description.en: Create the static server hosting public/.

description.zh: 返回前端首页 index.html。
description.en: Serve the index.html entry page.

description.zh: 按扩展名返回静态资源，越界路径返回 403。
description.en: Serve a static asset by extension; out-of-root paths get 403.

description.zh: 程序的开始与结束：开机自检、启动各项服务，以及收到退出信号时收拾干净。
description.en: The program's beginning and end: start-up checks, launching the services, and tidying up when asked to quit.

description.zh: 真正把程序跑起来：建好所有部件、监听端口，并恢复上次的登录。
description.en: Actually runs the program: builds every part, starts listening on the port, and restores the previous login.

description.zh: 进程主入口：构建、监听并启动周边服务。
description.en: Process entry: build, listen and start surrounding services.

label.zh: 启动已存账号的机器人

description.zh: 退出时按顺序收尾：先告知监控要停了，再关掉定时器和机器人，最后安全地存好数据库。
description.en: Shuts down in order: tells you monitoring is stopping, stops the timers and bots, and closes the database safely.

description.zh: 停止全部服务并安全关闭资源。
description.en: Stop all services and close resources safely.

description.zh: 开机自检：找到加密钥匙；如果钥匙已经打不开旧数据，就清空重来。
description.en: Start-up checks: find the encryption key, and if it no longer matches the saved data, wipe and start over.

description.zh: 按优先级解析主密钥与加密模式。
description.en: Resolve the master key and encryption mode by priority.

description.zh: 解密自检，失败则清库并退出重启。
description.en: Decryptability self-check; wipe and restart on failure.

description.zh: 按顺序组装各部件：先数据库和日志，再 VRChat 客户端、QQ、监控，最后网页服务。
description.en: Assembles the parts in order: database and logs first, then the VRChat client, QQ and monitoring, and finally the web server.

description.zh: 准备底层设施：打开数据库、接管日志、建立头像缓存。
description.en: Sets up the basics: opens the database, takes over logging, and creates the avatar cache.

description.zh: 打开仓储并启用可选加密。
description.en: Open the repository with optional encryption.

description.zh: 建立内存环形日志流并接管全局。
description.en: Create and globally install the in-memory ring log stream.

description.zh: 建立头像磁盘缓存。
description.en: Create the on-disk avatar cache.

name.zh: HTTP 组装与令牌加星号

description.zh: 创建网页服务，并让访问令牌在日志里显示为星号。
description.en: Creates the web server, and makes sure the access token is masked in logs.

description.zh: 组装完整应用（可注入依赖，便于测试）。
description.en: Build the complete application with injectable dependencies for tests.

description.zh: 创建干活的各个部件并接在一起：VRChat 客户端、世界名查询、QQ 机器人、通知、实时连接和监控。
description.en: Creates the working parts and connects them: the VRChat client, world-name lookup, the QQ bot, notifications, the live connection and monitoring.

description.zh: 组装 VRChat/QQ/通知/管线/监控服务。
description.en: Wire VRChat, QQ, notifier, pipeline and monitor services.

description.zh: 数据都存在哪里，以及好友状态是怎么判断出来的。
description.en: Where everything is stored, and how a friend's state is worked out from what the code sees.

description.zh: 查过的世界名和群名，留着下次直接用。
description.en: World and group names already looked up, kept so the next request can reuse them.

description.zh: 读取世界名缓存行。
description.en: Read a cached world name row.

description.zh: 写入已解析世界名与时间戳。
description.en: Upsert a resolved world name with its timestamp.

description.zh: 读取群组名缓存行。
description.en: Read a cached group name row.

description.zh: 写入群组名及失败计数与重试时间。
description.en: Upsert a group name with its failure count and retry time.

description.zh: 给敏感字段加密和解密；钥匙对不上时能发现，并清空重来。
description.en: Encrypts and decrypts sensitive fields, and notices when the key no longer fits so it can start fresh.

description.zh: 判断已存密文能否用当前密钥解开。
description.en: True when stored ciphertext cannot be read with the current key.

description.zh: 删除除访问令牌外的全部数据。
description.en: Delete everything except the access token.

description.zh: 就地解密用户行的敏感列。
description.en: Decrypt the sensitive columns of a user row in place.

description.zh: 记着刚刚发过哪些通知，避免同一件事重复发。
description.en: Remembers which notifications were just sent, so the same thing is not sent twice.

description.zh: 写入或刷新去重键，并把表裁剪回上限之内。
description.en: Record or refresh a dedupe key and trim the table back under its cap.

description.zh: 判断该键是否在给定窗口内出现过。
description.en: True when the key was seen inside the given window.

description.zh: 每个好友要收哪些通知。
description.en: Which notifications you want for each friend.

description.zh: 一次性整组写入某个好友的五个通知开关。
description.en: Replace all five notification flags for one friend at once.

description.zh: 判断好友状态变化的规则；纯计算，不碰数据库。
description.en: The rules for deciding what changed — pure logic, with no database access.

description.zh: 把一次变化整理成两个结果：要不要通知你，以及要写什么进数据库。
description.en: Turns one change into two answers: whether to notify you, and what to write to the database.

description.zh: 应用一次输入，返回落库更新、通知判定与变更负载。
description.en: Apply one input and return the persistence update, notification decision and change payload.

description.zh: 由转移组装通知负载。
description.en: Assemble the notification payload from a transition.

description.zh: 从位置信息判断这个好友算在游戏里、离线，还是只开了网页。
description.en: Works out from the location whether a friend counts as in-game, offline, or just on the website.

description.zh: 由位置字符串派生在线状态。
description.en: Derive presence from a location string.

description.zh: 由快照派生状态，优先使用当前用户的三个状态数组。
description.en: Derive presence from a snapshot, preferring the current user's status arrays.

description.zh: 新旧状态一比，判断是上线、下线、换世界还是改了状态。
description.en: Compares the old and new state to decide whether this is coming online, going offline, switching world or changing status.

description.zh: 把转移分类为变更类型、通知字段与是否需要确认。
description.en: Classify a transition into a change type, notify field and confirmation need.

description.zh: 好友的名单，以及每个人当前的状态。头像只占一个列（avatar_url）；两条写入路径都用 COALESCE，空值不覆盖旧值。
description.en: The friend list and each friend's current state. Avatars occupy a single column (avatar_url); both write paths coalesce, so an empty value never overwrites an existing one.

description.zh: 插入或更新好友，并告知是否为新好友。
description.en: Insert or update a friend, reporting whether it is new.

description.zh: 按显示名排序列出全部好友。
description.en: List every friend ordered by display name.

description.zh: 读取单个好友行。
description.en: Read one friend row.

description.zh: 更新资料字段，空值不回退。
description.en: Update profile fields, coalescing empty values.

description.zh: 写入在线状态，接收状态机产出的 snake_case 形状。
description.en: Write presence state, taking the snake_case shape produced by the state machine.

description.zh: 删除好友行。
description.en: Remove a friend row.

description.zh: 读懂 VRChat 的位置字符串，拆出好友在哪个世界、哪个房间。
description.en: Reads VRChat's location string and pulls out which world and which room the friend is in.

description.zh: 把位置标签解析为世界 id、实例 id、标志与类型。
description.en: Parse a location tag into world id, instance id, flags and kind.

description.zh: 判断该标签是否为真实实例世界。
description.en: True when the tag denotes a real instanced world.

description.zh: 退出登录时清掉这个账号的数据；也可以顺手清缓存和设置。
description.en: Clears the account's data when you log out, and can also clear caches and settings.

description.zh: 登出时清除好友、去重行与用户。
description.en: Clear friends, dedupe rows and users on logout.

description.zh: 清除设置与 QQ 绑定但保留访问令牌。
description.en: Clear settings and QQ bindings but keep the access token.

description.zh: 清空世界名缓存。
description.en: Clear the world name cache.

description.zh: 清空群组名缓存。
description.en: Clear the group name cache.

description.zh: 记着你用哪个 QQ 跟机器人说过话，通知就发到那里。
description.en: Records which QQ account has talked to the bot, so notifications know where to go.

description.zh: 写入绑定并返回落库后的行。
description.en: Upsert a binding and return the stored row.

description.zh: 读取某个 QQ 应用 id 的绑定。
description.en: Read the binding for a QQ app id.

description.zh: 数据库的表结构，以及把旧版本数据库升级到新结构的过程。
description.en: The database tables, and the process that upgrades an older database to the current shape.

description.zh: 打开数据库并把表结构升级到最新。
description.en: Open the database and converge it to the current schema.

description.zh: 先 checkpoint WAL 再关闭连接。
description.en: Checkpoint the WAL then close the connection.

description.zh: 账号行、凭据与自身在线状态。
description.en: Account rows, credentials and self presence.

description.zh: 好友行及逐好友通知开关。
description.en: Friend rows with per-friend notification flags.

description.zh: 通用键值设置表。
description.en: Generic key/value settings table.

description.zh: 带时间戳的通知去重键。
description.en: Notification dedupe keys with timestamps.

description.zh: QQ 应用与 openid 的绑定。
description.en: QQ app to openid bindings.

description.zh: 已解析的世界名。
description.en: Resolved world names.

description.zh: 已解析的群组名及失败退避。
description.en: Resolved group names with failure backoff.

description.zh: 磁盘上的 SQLite 数据库文件。
description.en: SQLite database file on disk.

description.zh: 全局设置，比如 QQ 机器人的开关和密钥。
description.en: Global settings such as the QQ bot switch and its secret.

description.zh: 读取白名单设置并解密密钥字段。
description.en: Read the whitelisted settings with the secret decrypted.

description.zh: 合并部分更新，忽略非白名单键并归一整数类型。
description.en: Merge a partial update, ignoring unknown keys and coercing integer types.

description.zh: 绕过白名单与加密的裸设置读取。
description.en: Raw setting read that bypasses the whitelist and crypto.

description.zh: 写入访问令牌等内部键的裸设置写入。
description.en: Raw setting write used for internal keys such as the access token.

description.zh: 保存你的账号和登录凭据；敏感内容都是加密存的。
description.en: Stores your account and login credentials; anything sensitive is kept encrypted.

description.zh: 插入或更新账号行并返回本地 id。
description.en: Insert or update an account row and return its local id.

description.zh: 更新显示资料字段。
description.en: Update display profile fields.

description.zh: 更新自身在线状态字段。
description.en: Update self presence fields.

description.zh: 按 VRChat id 读用户并解密敏感列。
description.en: Read one user by VRChat id, decrypting sensitive columns.

description.zh: 读取记住我保存的登录行。
description.en: Read the remember-me login row.

description.zh: 保存 cookie 与用户名，并先清除其他账号的 cookie。
description.en: Persist cookies and username, clearing any other account's cookies first.

description.zh: 保存密码用于自动重登。
description.en: Persist the password for automatic re-login.

description.zh: 各处都要用到的底层能力：日志、加密、头像缓存。
description.en: The low-level pieces everything else leans on: logging, encryption and the avatar cache.

description.zh: 好友头像下载一次就存在本地，下次直接给。
description.en: Downloads a friend's avatar once, keeps it locally, and serves it from there.

description.zh: 定期清掉很久没用的头像；太多了就淘汰最旧的。
description.en: Cleans up avatars that have not been used for a long time, and drops the oldest when there are too many.

description.zh: 删除超过 TTL 未访问的缓存项。
description.en: Delete cache entries older than the TTL.

description.zh: 清空缓存目录内容，保留目录本身。
description.en: Empty the cache directory, keeping the directory itself.

description.zh: 超过文件数上限时按最旧淘汰。
description.en: Evict the oldest entries past the file count cap.

description.zh: 启动周期性清理。
description.en: Start the periodic sweep.

description.zh: 从头像地址推出本地文件名，反过来也能推回去。
description.en: Turns an avatar address into a local filename, and back again.

description.zh: 把任意 VRChat 头像 URL 归一为指定尺寸的缩略图 URL。
description.en: Normalize any VRChat avatar URL to a thumbnail URL at the requested size.

description.zh: 由缩略图 URL 推导缓存 key。
description.en: Derive the cache key from a thumbnail URL.

description.zh: 由缓存 key 反推上游下载地址，形状不对则返回 null。
description.en: Rebuild the upstream download URL from a cache key, or null if malformed.

description.zh: 按魔数推断图片类型。
description.en: Detect the image type from magic bytes.

description.zh: 下载头像，并安全地写进磁盘。
description.en: Downloads an avatar and writes it to disk safely.

description.zh: 在指定目录上创建头像缓存。
description.en: Create the avatar cache over a directory.

description.zh: 确保本地有该图，同一 key 最多下载一次。
description.en: Ensure the image is cached locally, downloading at most once per key.

description.zh: 可读时返回缓存路径，否则 null。
description.en: Return the cached path when readable, else null.

description.zh: 刷新缓存文件的修改时间以续期。
description.en: Refresh a cache file's modification time to extend its TTL.

description.zh: 按缓存 key 命名的单个头像图片。
description.en: One cached avatar image, named by cache key.

description.zh: 给敏感数据加密；钥匙可以来自环境变量或 Docker 密钥文件。
description.en: Encrypts sensitive data; the key can come from an environment variable or a Docker secret file.

description.zh: 用 32 字节主密钥构造加解密器。
description.en: Build an encryptor/decryptor from a 32-byte master key.

description.zh: 按优先级解析密钥与模式：Docker Secret、环境变量或不加密。
description.en: Resolve the key and mode by priority: Docker secret, env var, or none.

description.zh: 解码 64 位 hex 或 32 字节 base64 密钥。
description.en: Decode a 64-hex or 32-byte base64 key.

description.zh: 从 Docker Secret 挂载点读取主密钥。
description.en: Read the master key from the Docker secret mount.

description.zh: 日志的三层：写日志的那只手、内存里最近的一段、硬盘上的完整历史。
description.en: Logging in three layers: the writer, the recent lines kept in memory, and the full history on disk.

description.zh: 日志写进多个文件，写满就换一个，太老的自动删掉。
description.en: Writes logs into several files, starting a new one when the current is full and deleting the oldest when there are too many.

description.zh: 把一行日志写进去；当前文件满了就换一个新的。
description.en: Writes one line, starting a new file when the current one is full.

description.zh: 追加一行并返回推导出的序号。
description.en: Append a line and return its derived sequence number.

description.zh: 在日志里定位：某一行大概在哪个文件、哪个位置。
description.en: Finds where a given line lives among the log files.

description.zh: 已写入的最大序号。
description.en: The highest sequence number written so far.

description.zh: 决定日志文件叫什么名字，并负责打开和关闭。
description.en: Names the log files, and opens and closes them.

description.zh: 打开日志目录并开启新段。
description.en: Open the log directory and start a fresh segment.

description.zh: 释放全部已打开的段句柄。
description.en: Release every open segment handle.

description.zh: 以 UTC 创建时间命名的单个日志段文件。
description.en: One segment file named by its UTC creation time.

description.zh: 往前翻或往后翻，只挑出符合筛选条件的行。
description.en: Pages forwards or backwards, returning only the lines that match the filter.

description.zh: 读取某序号之前最近的匹配行。
description.en: Read the newest matching lines before a sequence number.

description.zh: 读取某序号之后的匹配行。
description.en: Read matching lines after a sequence number.

description.zh: 统一的日志格式：时间、级别、类别、正文，同时送去终端和日志文件。
description.en: One format for every line — time, level, category, text — sent to the terminal and the log file at the same time.

description.zh: 创建绑定默认分类的日志器。
description.en: Create a logger bound to a default category.

description.zh: 提取行首 [分类] 标签并归一旧式别名。
description.en: Extract a leading [category] tag and normalize legacy aliases.

description.zh: 在内存里留着最近几百条日志，给面板实时显示。
description.en: Keeps the most recent lines in memory for the panel's live log view.

description.zh: 创建带订阅者的有界环形缓冲。
description.en: Create a bounded ring buffer with subscribers.

description.zh: 追加一行，可接受外部推导的序号。
description.en: Append a line, accepting an externally derived sequence number.

description.zh: 重写某个序号的行并通知订阅者。
description.en: Rewrite the line at a sequence number and notify subscribers.

description.zh: 返回某序号之后的行，用于断线补缺口。
description.en: Return lines after a sequence number for reconnect gap filling.

description.zh: 把时间显示成本地时间，方便跟自己的钟对照。
description.en: Shows times in your local timezone so they are easy to compare with your own clock.

description.zh: 把时间戳格式化为本地 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss。
description.en: Format a timestamp as local YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.

description.zh: 两个小工具：把令牌加星号显示，以及「等太久就先用旧值」。
description.en: Two small helpers: showing a token with most of it hidden, and falling back to an old value instead of waiting forever.

description.zh: 全项目唯一决定"取哪张头像"的地方：iconUrl 优先（好友 schema 唯一声明的头像字段，也是 REST 快照与 WS 事件唯一都有的），缺失时退回 currentAvatarImageUrl。已不再返回的两个缩略图字段刻意不读。
description.en: The one place that decides which avatar a user gets: iconUrl first (the only avatar field the friend schema declares, and the only one both the REST snapshot and the WS events carry), falling back to currentAvatarImageUrl. The two thumbnail fields VRChat stopped returning are deliberately not read.

description.zh: 把 VRChat user 对象映射成本项目唯一的头像字段。
description.en: Map a VRChat user object onto this project's single avatar field.

description.zh: 给一个操作设个时限；超时就用备用的旧值先返回，不再干等。
description.en: Puts a time limit on an operation; on timeout it returns the fallback value instead of waiting.

description.zh: 让 promise 与超时竞争，超时用兜底值兑现。
description.en: Race a promise against a timeout, resolving with a fallback value.

name.zh: 令牌加星号与信任等级

description.zh: 把令牌加星号显示，并把信任标签换算成人能看懂的等级名。
description.en: Masks a token for display, and turns trust tags into a readable level name.

description.zh: 令牌加星号，仅保留前四后四位。
description.en: Mask a token keeping only its first and last four characters.

description.zh: 把 VRChat 信任标签映射为官方等级名。
description.en: Map VRChat trust tags to the official trust level name.

description.zh: 监控的总指挥：盯着好友的一举一动，判断哪些值得告诉你。
description.en: The conductor of the whole thing: watches what your friends are doing and decides whether it is worth telling you.

description.zh: 把监控需要的部件装到一起，并记住当前在监控哪个账号。
description.en: Assembles the parts monitoring needs and remembers which accounts are currently being watched.

description.zh: 注入依赖与上限值，创建监控总控实例。
description.en: Create the monitor with all collaborators and thresholds.

description.zh: 惰性构造单个用户的连接态记录。
description.en: Lazily materialise the per-user connection state record.

description.zh: 网络断了或登录失效时先安静等一会儿；拖得太久才提醒你一次，恢复了再补一句。
description.en: When the connection drops or a login expires it stays quiet at first; only a longer outage is worth a message, and recovery gets a short follow-up.

description.zh: 经通知渠道推送系统通知。
description.en: Push a system notification through the notification channels.

description.zh: 每次连接只发一次的启动/恢复说明。
description.en: Send the startup or recovery notice once per connection.

description.zh: 开启故障窗口并挂起延迟故障通知。
description.en: Start the fault window and arm the delayed failure notice.

description.zh: 判定恢复（API 正常且 WS 已连）并发送恢复说明。
description.en: Evaluate recovery (API ok and WS connected) and send the recovery notice.

description.zh: 为群组公告查群名；查不到就算了，不耽耽误发通知。
description.en: Looks up group names for announcement notifications; if that fails it carries on rather than holding up the notification.

description.zh: 判断缓存群名是否仍可用。
description.en: Decide whether the cached group name is still usable.

description.zh: 先批量拉用户群组再单查，失败后等得一次比一次久。
description.en: Resolve a group name via bulk user-groups then a single lookup, waiting longer after each failure.

description.zh: 决定哪些消息真的发给你，以及长什么样。
description.en: Decides which messages actually reach you, and what they look like.

description.zh: 好友状态变了：先看这个好友有没有开通知、是不是刚发过，然后才发。
description.en: A friend changed state: check that this friend has notifications on and that one was not just sent, then send.

description.zh: 按逐好友开关把关、去重、补全并发送一条好友变更。
description.en: Gate on the per-friend flag, dedupe, enrich and send one friend change.

description.zh: 同一个人先改状态、紧跟着又换世界时，把两条合成一条发。
description.en: When someone changes status and then switches world within a moment, merges the two into one message.

description.zh: 把中文变更类型映射为消费方使用的事件类型。
description.en: Map a Chinese change type to the event type used by consumers.

description.zh: 短暂延迟状态变化，让紧随的切世界合并成一条。
description.en: Delay a status change briefly so an immediate world switch can merge into one message.

description.zh: 处理 VRChat 站内通知，但只转发你关心的三类：世界邀请、戳一戳、群组公告。
description.en: Handles VRChat's own notifications, but only forwards the three kinds you care about: world invites, boops and group announcements.

description.zh: 从通知负载中提取世界 id 与名称。
description.en: Extract a world id and name from a notification payload.

description.zh: 从通知负载中提取群组 id。
description.en: Extract a group id from a notification payload.

description.zh: 过滤、富化并推送一条 VRChat 站内通知。
description.en: Filter, enrich and push a VRChat in-app notification.

description.zh: VRChat 推来的每条消息，先判断要不要管，再分给对应的地方。
description.en: Every message VRChat pushes is first checked, then handed to the right place.

description.zh: 决定这条消息收不收、归谁管：未完成对账前一律忽略，会话不存在时丢弃，没有 content 的消息直接丢弃，其余按 type 分派。
description.en: Decides whether to accept a message and which part should handle it: messages are ignored until reconciliation finishes, dropped when the caller's session is gone, and dropped outright when content is missing; everything else is dispatched by type.

description.zh: 准入检查、按类型分派与外层异常兜底。
description.en: Admission checks, per-type dispatch and the outer error guard.

description.zh: 好友的七种消息分别怎么处理：上线、活动、下线、换世界、改资料、加好友、删好友。这些分支在 handlePipelineEvent 的 switch 里内联实现，没有独立的处理函数；除 friend-offline 外每个分支都带 user 对象。
description.en: How each of the seven friend messages is handled: online, active, offline, world change, profile edit, add and delete. The branches are inline in handlePipelineEvent's switch, with no dedicated handler function; every case but friend-offline carries a user object.

description.zh: 好友上线（或从网页端转入游戏），带 user 对象与世界位置。
description.en: A friend came online (or moved from web into the game); carries a user object and a world location.

description.zh: 好友变为网页在线，无世界信息。
description.en: A friend became web-active; no world information.

description.zh: 好友下线；不带 user 对象，只更新在线状态并清空世界。
description.en: A friend went offline; carries no user object, only clears presence and world.

description.zh: 好友换房间；traveling 时保留旧世界名与实例号。
description.en: A friend switched world; a traveling state keeps the previous world name and instance.

description.zh: 好友改资料（昵称/头像/状态）；字段缺失时继承旧值。
description.en: A friend edited their profile (name/avatar/status); missing fields inherit the old value.

description.zh: 新增好友。location 只在事件信封里（WS 的 user 对象没有该字段），所以在线状态、世界与平台都从信封加 last_platform 推导。
description.en: A friend was added. location lives only in the event envelope (the WS user object has no such field), so presence, world and platform are derived from the envelope plus last_platform.

description.zh: 删除好友行，并清理它的待验证状态。
description.en: Removes the friend row and clears its pending-verification state.

description.zh: 断线重连后先整体核对一遍，看看这段时间漏了什么。
description.en: After a reconnect, re-checks everything first to catch whatever was missed while disconnected.

description.zh: 重连后先挡住 WS 消息并跑一次完整核对。
description.en: Block WS messages and run a full check after reconnecting.

description.zh: 你自己改资料或换房间时的处理。这两个分支在 handlePipelineEvent 的 switch 里内联实现，没有独立的处理函数。
description.en: Handles your own profile changes and world switches. Both cases are inline in handlePipelineEvent's switch; there is no dedicated handler function.

description.zh: 自己资料变化（昵称/头像/状态），带完整 user 对象。
description.en: Own profile change (name/avatar/status) carrying a full user object.

description.zh: 自己换房间；offline 或空位置按网页在线处理。
description.en: Own world switch; an offline or empty location is treated as web-online.

description.zh: 开启或停止监控某个账号；启动时先安静地读一遗现状，免得一开机就发一堆通知。
description.en: Starts and stops watching an account; on start it reads the current state quietly, so you do not get a burst of notifications.

description.zh: 注册用户、连接管线并安静地做一次首次核对。
description.en: Register a user, connect the pipeline and run the first quiet check.

description.zh: 反注册用户并清理其管线与定时器。
description.en: Unregister a user and tear down its pipeline and timers.

description.zh: 活跃会话的浅拷贝视图。
description.en: Snapshot view of active sessions.

description.zh: 向全部活跃用户推送监控停止通知。
description.en: Notify every active user that monitoring is stopping.

description.zh: 定时把所有好友的现状重新核一遍，作为最可靠的依据。
description.en: Periodically re-reads every friend's current state, which is the most reliable source of truth.

description.zh: 核对时被拒绝，判断是密码过期了、需要验证码，还是会话彻底失效。
description.en: When the check is refused, works out whether the password expired, a code is needed, or the session is truly dead.

description.zh: 把 401 分流为自动重登、2FA 重验证或会话失效。
description.en: Split a 401 into relogin-needed, unauthorized-2fa or session-expired.

description.zh: 把核对到哪一步了告诉等待页，让进度条如实走动。
description.en: Tells the waiting screen how far the check has got, so the progress bar stays honest.

description.zh: 上报点亮等待页的登录进度阶段。
description.en: Report the login-progress stage that lights up the boot overlay.

description.zh: 一次完整核对：读出全部好友、逐个更新，发现已经不在好友列表里的就清理掉。
description.en: One full check: read every friend, update each one, and clean up anyone who is no longer a friend.

description.zh: 为单个用户执行一次完整核对。
description.en: Run one full check for a user.

description.zh: 把看到的情况写进数据库：好友的，还有你自己的。
description.en: Writes what was observed into the database — your friends' state and your own.

description.zh: 好友信息进数据库的唯一入口，变化与否也在这里判断。资料字段缺失时整段跳过更新，所以缺失的值不会覆盖已存的值。
description.en: The single entry point through which friend data reaches the database, and where it decides whether anything really changed. When a profile field is absent the update is skipped entirely, so a missing value never overwrites a stored one.

description.zh: 全部好友数据的唯一写库入口。
description.en: The single write path for all friend data.

description.zh: 刚看到好友下线时先不急着通知，过一会儿再确认一次，避免网络波动误报。
description.en: Does not announce a friend going offline right away; confirms again a moment later so a network hiccup is not reported as real.

description.zh: 为好友排期或顺延共享的下线确认定时器。
description.en: Schedule or refresh the shared offline-confirmation timer for a friend.

description.zh: 用一次 me() 复核该用户的全部 pending 好友。
description.en: Verify all pending friends for a user with a single me() call.

description.zh: 取消某个好友的待确认检查。
description.en: Cancel the pending check for a friend.

description.zh: 记录你自己的在线状态，只给面板看，不给你发通知。
description.en: Records your own presence for the panel only — it never triggers a notification.

description.zh: 把位置与 API 状态归一为自身在线状态。
description.en: Normalize a location and API state into the self presence state.

description.zh: 保存自身在线状态并通知面板。
description.en: Persist self presence and notify the panel.

description.zh: 安排什么时候自动核对、多久检查一次连接。
description.en: Schedules when to check again, and how often to look at the connection.

description.zh: 把最近一段时间的自动核对往后推。
description.en: Push the recent automatic checks back.

description.zh: 启动自动核对与静默检测定时器（重复调用也安全）。
description.en: Start the automatic check and silence-detection timers (safe to call twice).

description.zh: 停止两个定时器。
description.en: Stop both timers.

description.zh: 连接看着还在、但很久没消息了，就主动重连一次。
description.en: When a connection looks alive but has been silent for too long, reconnects it.

description.zh: 对长时间无消息的已连接用户强制重连。
description.en: Force a reconnect for any connected user whose socket has gone silent.

description.zh: 要世界名字的时候去查，但不会把等它的人拖住。
description.en: Looks up world names when asked, without making the caller wait longer than it should.

description.zh: 同步取缓存世界名；private 哨兵就地写死。
description.en: Synchronous cached world name; the private sentinel is hard-coded.

description.zh: 带调用侧时限地等待世界名，超时回退缓存旧名。
description.en: Await a world name with a caller-side deadline, falling back to the cached value.

description.zh: 把所有消息送到你的 QQ：机器人连接、它回你的话，以及消息模板。
description.en: Gets every message to your QQ: the bot connection, the replies it sends, and the message templates.

description.zh: QQ 官方机器人的连接与收发。
description.en: The connection and message handling for the official QQ bot.

name.zh: 机器人注册与生命周期

description.zh: 按你的设置启动和停止机器人，并告诉你它当前是什么状态。
description.en: Starts and stops the bot according to your settings, and reports what state it is in.

description.zh: 按已存设置调和运行中的机器人，返回变更计数。
description.en: Reconcile the running bots with the stored settings; returns change counts.

description.zh: 启动时按已存账号启动全部机器人。
description.en: Start bots for every saved account at startup.

description.zh: 停止单个机器人并解除绑定。
description.en: Stop one bot and forget its binding.

description.zh: 停止全部机器人。
description.en: Stop every bot.

description.zh: 报告配置/连接/令牌/绑定状态供面板展示。
description.en: Report configured/connected/token/bound state for the panel.

description.zh: 把消息发给 QQ；发太快会排队，失败了会重试。
description.en: Sends messages to QQ, queuing them so they do not go out too fast, and retrying failures.

description.zh: 发送主动文本或 Markdown 消息，按配置截断并重试。
description.en: Send a proactive text or markdown message, truncating and retrying as configured.

description.zh: 针对入站消息 id 做被动回复。
description.en: Reply passively to an inbound message id.

description.zh: 按绑定串行发送，并保持最小间隔。
description.en: Serialize sends per binding with a minimum spacing between them.

description.zh: 向 C2C 端点投递消息。
description.en: POST a message to the C2C endpoint.

description.zh: 和 QQ 服务器保持长连接，并定期报个到，让 QQ 知道它还活着。
description.en: Keeps a long-lived connection to QQ and reports in periodically so QQ knows it is still there.

description.zh: 打开网关、identify 并启动心跳。
description.en: Open the gateway, identify and start the heartbeat.

description.zh: 按 opcode 分发入站帧。
description.en: Dispatch an inbound frame by opcode.

description.zh: 用配置的 intents 发送 op 2 identify。
description.en: Send op 2 identify with the configured intents.

description.zh: 发送 op 1 心跳，长时间无 ack 则终止连接。
description.en: Send op 1 heartbeats and terminate after idle acknowledgements.

description.zh: 连接 QQ 机器人网关。
description.en: Connect to the QQ bot gateway.

description.zh: 领取并缓存机器人的访问凭据；凭据失效就提示你重新配置。
description.en: Gets and caches the bot's access credential; if it is rejected, tells you to set it up again.

description.zh: 获取并缓存应用访问令牌，合并并发请求。
description.en: Fetch and cache the app access token, coalescing concurrent requests.

description.zh: 凭据失效时清除 QQ 设置并停止机器人。
description.en: React to invalid credentials by clearing the QQ settings and stopping the bot.

description.zh: 向令牌端点提交 AppID 与 AppSecret。
description.en: POST the app id and client secret to the token endpoint.

description.zh: 你在 QQ 里发给机器人的消息，由这里回应。
description.en: Replies to the messages you send the bot.

name.zh: 指令处理与世界名补全

description.zh: 收到消息就回一份在线列表；正在等验证码时例外，那时直接发数字会被当成验证码。
description.en: Replies with the online list, except while a login code is expected — then a bare code is treated as the code.

description.zh: 处理一条入站聊天消息并产出回复。
description.en: Handle one inbound chat message and produce a reply.

description.zh: 在一个共享时限内为在线好友解析世界名。
description.en: Resolve world names for online friends under one shared deadline.

description.zh: 把在线好友整理成一张好读的列表。
description.en: Turns the online friends into a readable list.

description.zh: 把在线好友渲染为 Markdown 表格与对齐的纯文本两份。
description.en: Render the online friends as both a markdown table and padded plain text.

description.zh: 把社交状态映射为表情符号。
description.en: Map a social status to its emoji.

description.zh: 按宽字符占两列计算显示宽度。
description.en: Compute display width treating wide characters as two columns.

description.zh: 把一条变化渲染成消息并发出。
description.en: Renders a change into a message and sends it out.

description.zh: 渲染变更并经已启用的渠道发送。
description.en: Render a change and send it through the enabled channels.

description.zh: 不经模板直接发送原始文本。
description.en: Send raw text without going through a template.

description.zh: 发送一条合成测试通知。
description.en: Send a synthetic test notification.

description.zh: 消息长什么样：标题、正文，以及每种状态对应的说法和表情。
description.en: What messages look like: the title, the body, and the words and emoji used for each state.

description.zh: 按「好友变化」或「站内通知」两种格式拼出最终消息。
description.en: Assembles the final message, in either the friend-change or the in-app-notice format.

description.zh: 由变更构造 QQ 消息的标题与正文。
description.en: Build the title and body of a QQ message from a change.

description.zh: 渲染站内通知正文，剔除空行。
description.en: Render an in-app notification body, dropping blank lines.

description.zh: 判断是否为站内通知类系统事件。
description.en: True for in-app notification system events.

description.zh: 把状态换算成人话，并把昵称里的特殊符号转义。
description.en: Turns states into plain words, and escapes special characters in nicknames.

description.zh: 替换 {占位符}，null 视为空串。
description.en: Replace {placeholder} tokens, treating null as empty.

description.zh: 把变更与标签/表情展开成模板变量集。
description.en: Flatten a change plus labels and emoji into the template variable set.

description.zh: 为消息排版把字段分为有变化与无变化两组。
description.en: Split changed and unchanged fields for the message layout.

description.zh: 对动态值转义 Markdown 控制字符。
description.en: Escape markdown control characters in dynamic values.

description.zh: 网页面板和外部程序访问后端的入口：登录、好友、设置、状态、日志、头像。
description.en: How the web panel reaches the backend: login, friends, settings, status, logs and avatars.

description.zh: 两个不用令牌就能访问的接口：读基础配置、检查令牌对不对。
description.en: Two endpoints reachable without a token: read the basic config, and check whether a token is correct.

description.zh: 前端引导配置，无需令牌。
description.en: Bootstrap configuration for the UI; no token required.

description.zh: 检查前端提交的访问令牌，这个接口本身不需要令牌。
description.en: Verify a submitted access key; no token required.

description.zh: 登录相关的全部环节：密码登录、两步验证、自动重登、退出。
description.en: Everything about signing in: password login, two-factor codes, automatic re-login, and logout.

description.zh: 下次启动时自动恢复登录；失败就等一会儿再试，而且越试间隔越长。
description.en: Restores the previous login on the next start; on failure it retries with growing gaps between attempts.

description.zh: 带守卫的会话恢复（即发即忘）。
description.en: Fire-and-forget session restore with guards.

description.zh: 用已保存 cookie 恢复登录并分类失败原因。
description.en: Restore from saved cookies and classify failures.

description.zh: 重试的时间一次比一次等得久，并加一点随机。
description.en: Wait longer before each retry, with a little randomness.

description.zh: 判断已保存 cookie 是否全部过期。
description.en: True when every saved cookie is already expired.

description.zh: 推送一次性的登录过期通知。
description.en: Push a one-shot session-expired notice.

description.zh: 供 QQ 回复使用的连接状态。
description.en: Connection status used by QQ replies.

description.zh: 用账号密码登录；如果需要两步验证，就把验证码那一步交给下一环节。
description.en: Signs in with username and password; if a two-factor code is needed, hands that step on to the next module.

description.zh: 用户名密码登录，可能返回 2FA 挑战与临时会话 id。
description.en: Username/password login; may return a 2FA challenge and temp session id.

description.zh: 把 VRChat 登录错误映射为可操作提示。
description.en: Map VRChat login errors to actionable messages.

description.zh: 登录过期时用保存的密码自动重新登录；需要验证码时会到 QQ 上问你。
description.en: Re-logs in with the saved password when a session expires, and asks you for a code over QQ when needed.

description.zh: 一次次尝试重新登录：成功就继续，一直失败就放弃并告诉你。
description.en: Keeps attempting the re-login, carries on when it succeeds, and gives up with a notice if it keeps failing.

description.zh: 带着旧 cookie 与保存的密码执行一次重登。
description.en: Run one re-login attempt with old cookies plus the saved password.

description.zh: 为失败的重登排期退避重试。
description.en: Schedule a backoff retry for a failed re-login.

description.zh: 放弃重登、停用用户并发出会话失效事件。
description.en: Give up, deactivate the user and emit session-expired.

description.zh: 用于频控的滚动 1 小时尝试计数。
description.en: Rolling one-hour attempt counter for rate limiting.

name.zh: 重登验证码与 QQ 指令

description.zh: 接收重新登录需要的验证码——在网页弹窗里填，或在 QQ 里直接发。
description.en: Takes the code needed to finish a re-login, either typed into the panel or sent over QQ.

description.zh: 为挂起的运行中会话建立待验证 2FA 会话。
description.en: Start a 2FA pending session for an unauthorized running session.

description.zh: 验证待验证的验证码，成功后建立会话。
description.en: Verify a pending code and finalize the session.

description.zh: 清 cookie 保密码，重新触发验证码邮件。
description.en: Clear cookies but keep the password to re-trigger the code mail.

description.zh: 解析重发验证码与 4/6 位验证码的 QQ 钩子。
description.en: QQ hook parsing resend-code and 4/6-digit OTP messages.

description.zh: 从网页弹窗提交重登 2FA 验证码。
description.en: Submit the pending re-login 2FA code from the web modal.

description.zh: 登录成功后统一在这里收尾：记住账号、保存登录信息、开始监控。
description.en: The single place a successful login lands: remember the account, save the credentials, start monitoring.

description.zh: 四种登录入口共用的会话建立。
description.en: Shared landing path for every login entry point.

description.zh: 会话失效时丢弃当前会话。
description.en: Drop the current session when it expires.

description.zh: 登出并清账号数据，可选清缓存与设置。
description.en: Log out and clear account data, optionally caches and settings.

description.zh: 会话探测，未登录时触发自动登录。
description.en: Session probe that triggers auto-login when logged out.

description.zh: 返回当前用户。
description.en: Return the current user.

description.zh: 验证登录时的两步验证码，通过后正式建立登录状态。
description.en: Checks the two-factor code during login and, once correct, establishes the session.

description.zh: 用临时会话 id 与验证码完成登录 2FA。
description.en: Complete login 2FA with a temp session id and code.

description.zh: 把好友头像下载下来存在本地再发给面板，免得每次都去 VRChat 取。
description.en: Downloads friend avatars once, keeps them locally, and serves them to the panel instead of fetching every time.

description.zh: 按需下载并返回缓存头像；未登录 401，未知 key 404。
description.en: Serve a cached avatar, downloading on demand; 401 when logged out, 404 when unknown.

description.zh: 让面板读取好友列表，并勾选每个好友要收哪些通知。
description.en: Lets the panel read the friend list, and tick which notifications you want for each friend.

description.zh: 列出全部好友（含世界名、头像 key 与逐好友配置）。
description.en: List all friends with world name, avatar key and per-friend config.

description.zh: 写入单个好友的通知配置。
description.en: Upsert one friend's notification configuration.

description.zh: 面板里的日志窗口：能按级别和类别筛选，也能往回翻历史。
description.en: The log window in the panel: filter by level and category, and scroll back through history.

description.zh: 判断某一行日志是不是你选中的级别和类别。
description.en: Decides whether a log line matches the levels and categories you selected.

description.zh: 按选中的等级与分类集合匹配日志行。
description.en: Match a log line against the selected levels and categories.

description.zh: 解析筛选参数：省略即不过滤，空串即不匹配任何行。
description.en: Parse a filter query: omitted means no filter, empty means match nothing.

description.zh: 按三种方式取日志：最新的、某条之后的、某条之前的历史。
description.en: Fetches logs in three ways: the newest lines, everything after a given line, or older history.

description.zh: 按 tail、after=seq（SSE 补缺口）或 before=seq（向前翻页）查询日志，服务端筛选并加星号。
description.en: Query logs by tail, by seq after (SSE gap fill) or by seq before, with server-side filtering and token masking.

label.en: Fall back to the ring buffer

description.zh: 每个请求都要先过的几道关：解析内容、允许跨域、检查令牌、出错兜底。
description.en: The checks every request passes through: parse the body, allow cross-origin calls, verify the token, and catch errors.

description.zh: 检查请求有没有带对的访问令牌。
description.en: Checks that a request carries the right access token.

description.zh: 除白名单外全部 /api 请求都要检查 Bearer 或查询串里的令牌。
description.en: Gate every /api request except the whitelist on a Bearer or query token.

description.zh: 先比长度，再用恒定耗时的方式比较令牌。
description.en: Length-checked, timing-safe token comparison.

description.zh: 万一出错，记下原因并回一句「服务器内部错误」，而不是直接崩掉。
description.en: If something throws, logs the reason and answers with a plain server error instead of crashing.

description.zh: 记录错误并在未发头时返回 500 JSON。
description.en: Log the error and return 500 JSON unless headers were sent.

description.zh: 解析请求内容，并允许面板从别的网址调用后端。
description.en: Parses request bodies and allows the panel to be served from another address.

description.zh: 解析最大 1MB 的 JSON 请求体。
description.en: Parse JSON bodies up to 1MB.

description.zh: 写入 CORS 头，预检直接回 204。
description.en: Set CORS headers and answer preflight with 204.

description.zh: 两个手动按钮：立即刷新一次好友状态、发一条测试通知。
description.en: Two manual buttons: refresh friend status right now, and send a test notification.

description.zh: 手动触发一次完整核对。
description.en: Manually trigger one full check.

description.zh: 按渠道类型发送测试通知。
description.en: Send a test notification for a channel kind.

description.zh: 组装网页服务本身，并记住当前是谁登录着。
description.en: Builds the web server itself and keeps track of who is currently logged in.

description.zh: 创建 Express 应用及自动登录入口。
description.en: Create the Express app plus the auto-login entry.

description.zh: 从已保存 cookie 恢复会话（即发即忘）。
description.en: Fire-and-forget session restore from saved cookies.

description.zh: 把数据库行转成前端零解析的响应，并在出站时脱敏：补世界名（同步 peek 缓存）、按唯一头像地址（avatar_url）推出头像缓存 key（与写库用的 util.avatarFields 同源）、补嵌套好友配置，从用户行剔除 cookie_data/密码，对 QQ AppSecret 打码，并在所有出站日志行中替换访问令牌。
description.en: Turns database rows into frontend-ready payloads and scrubs secrets on the way out: adds world name (sync cache peek), the avatar cache key derived from the single stored avatar_url (same rule the writers use via util.avatarFields) and nested friend config, strips cookie_data/password from user rows, masks the QQ app secret, and replaces the access token in every outbound log line.

description.zh: 为好友行补充 world_name/avatarKey/逐好友配置；avatarKey 由 avatar_url 换算。
description.en: Attach world_name, avatarKey and per-friend config to a friend row.

description.zh: 序列化当前用户（含头像 key 与世界名）。
description.en: Serialize the current user with avatar key and world name.

description.zh: 从用户行中移除 cookie 与密码。
description.en: Drop cookie data and password from a user row.

description.zh: 把设置里的密钥字段加星号。
description.en: Mask secret settings fields.

description.zh: 把要发出去的文本里的访问令牌换成星号。
description.en: Replace the configured access token on outbound text.

description.zh: 用缓存同步补世界名，不发请求。
description.en: Read a cached world name without issuing a request.

description.zh: 为一批行触发后台世界名查询。
description.en: Kick background world-name lookups for a batch of rows.

description.zh: 把逐好友通知开关还原成嵌套 config 形状。
description.en: Project per-friend notification flags into the nested config shape.

description.zh: 读取和修改设置，比如 QQ 机器人的开关和密钥。密钥读出来是加星号的。
description.en: Reads and changes settings such as the QQ bot switch and its secret; the secret is never returned in full.

description.zh: 读取全局设置（密钥加星号）。
description.en: Read global settings with secrets masked.

description.zh: 更新全局设置并重新同步 QQ 机器人。
description.en: Update global settings and resync the QQ bot.

description.zh: 后端主动往浏览器推消息的通道：状态变化、新通知、日志。
description.en: The channel the backend uses to push updates to the browser: status changes, new notifications, logs.

description.zh: 把一条消息同时发给所有打开的面板；发给谁失败就把他去掉。
description.en: Sends one message to every open page, and drops any page that fails to receive it.

description.zh: 向单个客户端写一帧 event/data。
description.en: Write one event/data frame to a client.

description.zh: 向全部客户端广播事件，失败即摘除。
description.en: Broadcast an event to all clients, evicting failures.

description.zh: 把每条后端日志转发为 log 或 log-update。
description.en: Forward every backend log line as log or log-update.

name.zh: 事件总线桥接与 WS 统计
name.en: Bus to SSE Bridge & WS Stats

description.zh: 把程序内部发生的事情，转成浏览器能收到的事件。
description.en: Turns things happening inside the program into events the browser can receive.

description.zh: 把后端总线事件映射为 SSE 事件并重发状态。
description.en: Map backend bus events onto SSE events and status re-broadcasts.

description.zh: 每秒补推最近几秒的 WS 消息数。
description.en: Push the last seconds of WS message counts every second.

description.zh: 浏览器订阅实时事件的地址；空闲时也会定时打个招呼，避免连接被断开。
description.en: The address the browser subscribes to; it sends a small ping so the connection is not dropped while idle.

description.zh: 开启 SSE 流：先发连接注释帧，之后每 25 秒 ping 保活。
description.en: Open the SSE stream with an initial comment frame and a 25s ping heartbeat.

description.zh: 顺带把网页文件也发出去，这样前后端可以只跑在一台机器上。
description.en: Also serves the web page files, so front end and back end can share one machine.

description.zh: 在配置了 publicDir 时托管前端静态资源。
description.en: Serve the built frontend from publicDir when configured.

description.zh: 面板顶上那排状态：在线情况、连接好不好、延迟多少，以及 VRChat 官方是否正常。
description.en: The status strip at the top of the panel: who is online, connection health, latency, and whether VRChat itself is up.

description.zh: /api/status 与 SSE status 事件共用的聚合状态。
description.en: Aggregate status payload shared by /api/status and the SSE status event.

description.zh: 统一的状态数据，不检查登录。
description.en: Unified status payload; no login check.

description.zh: 最近一轮 VRChat API 健康探测结果。
description.en: Latest VRChat API health probe result.

description.zh: 最近 60 秒每秒 WS 消息数。
description.en: Per-second WS message counts for the last 60 seconds.

description.zh: 来自 status.vrchat.com 的 VRChat 服务状态。
description.en: VRChat service status from status.vrchat.com.

description.zh: 所有跟 VRChat 打交道的事：登录、拉好友、收实时消息，以及查世界名和服务状态。
description.en: Everything that talks to VRChat: signing in, reading friends, the live message feed, plus world names and service health.

description.zh: 调 VRChat 官方接口的客户端。
description.en: The client that calls VRChat's official API.

description.zh: 登录、验证码、读自己的资料。
description.en: Signing in, verifying codes, and reading your own profile.

description.zh: 读取当前用户（GET /auth/user）。
description.en: GET /auth/user as the current user.

description.zh: 读取指定用户的公开资料。
description.en: GET /users/{id} for a public profile.

description.zh: 获取 WebSocket 令牌（GET /auth）。
description.en: GET /auth for the WebSocket token.

description.zh: 用 HTTP Basic 凭据登录，需要时返回 2FA 挑战。
description.en: Login with HTTP Basic credentials; returns a 2FA challenge when required.

description.zh: 验证两步验证码，8 位邮箱码格式化为 xxxx-xxxx。
description.en: Verify a two-factor code; 8-digit email codes become xxxx-xxxx.

description.zh: 拉好友列表、查世界和群组。
description.en: Reads the friend list and looks up worlds and groups.

description.zh: 分页好友列表；offline 选离线名册，onPage 上报进度。
description.en: Paged friend list; offline selects the offline roster and onPage reports progress.

description.zh: 读取世界信息（GET /worlds/{id}）。
description.en: GET /worlds/{id}.

description.zh: 读取群组信息（需登录态）。
description.en: GET /groups/{id} (requires login).

description.zh: 读取用户加入的全部群组。
description.en: GET /users/{id}/groups, returning every membership at once.

description.zh: 真正发请求的地方：控制请求频率，遇到临时故障会重试。
description.en: Where requests are actually sent: keeps the request rate in check, and retries temporary failures.

description.zh: 带 cookie 处理、限流与退避地发起一次请求。
description.en: Issue one request with cookie handling, rate limiting and backoff.

description.zh: 执行真正的 fetch，吸收 Set-Cookie 并抛出 ApiError。
description.en: Perform the fetch, absorb Set-Cookie and raise ApiError.

description.zh: 判断是否为凭据缺失类 401。
description.en: Classify a 401 as missing credentials.

description.zh: 判断是否为会话挂起类 401。
description.en: True when the error is a suspended-session 401.

description.zh: 记住 VRChat 给的登录凭据，让后续请求不用重新登录。
description.en: Remembers the credentials VRChat hands out, so later requests do not need to sign in again.

description.zh: 解析一个或多个 Set-Cookie 头并入库。
description.en: Parse one or more Set-Cookie headers into the jar.

description.zh: 为指定 URL 构造 Cookie 请求头。
description.en: Build the Cookie request header for a URL.

description.zh: 序列化 jar 以便加密持久化。
description.en: Serialize the jar for encrypted persistence.

description.zh: 从持久化 JSON 重建 jar，容忍数据损坏。
description.en: Rebuild a jar from persisted JSON, tolerating corruption.

description.zh: 定时探一下 VRChat，看它响应快不快。
description.en: Pings VRChat regularly to see how responsive it is.

description.zh: 探测公开 config 端点并取计时样本平均。
description.en: Probe the public config endpoint and average the timing samples.

description.zh: 启动周期性探测。
description.en: Start periodic probing.

description.zh: 停止探测。
description.en: Stop probing.

description.zh: 返回最近一次平均采样。
description.en: Return the latest averaged sample.

description.zh: 和 VRChat 的实时通道：好友动态从这条线推过来。
description.en: The live channel to VRChat: friend activity arrives through it.

description.zh: 建立并维持连接；断了就重连，越连不上间隔越长。
description.en: Opens and keeps the connection; if it drops it reconnects, waiting longer each time.

description.zh: 建立连接：取令牌、连上、绑定 open/message/close/error。
description.en: Open the socket: fetch a token, connect, wire open/message/close/error.

description.zh: 下一次重连的时间一次比一次等得久，并加一点随机。
description.en: Wait longer before each reconnect, with a little randomness.

description.zh: 启动协议 ping，并在收不到 pong 时断开卡住的连接。
description.en: Start the protocol ping with a pong watchdog terminating zombie sockets.

description.zh: 断线时间超过上限后升级到故障回调。
description.en: Escalate to the failure callback once a disconnect window exceeds the threshold.

description.zh: 连接的开关：连上、断开、强制重连、看状态。
description.en: The switch for the connection: open it, close it, force a reconnect, or read its state.

description.zh: 连接某个用户（即发即忘包装）。
description.en: Connect a user (fire-and-forget wrapper).

description.zh: 主动断开某用户，不再安排重连。
description.en: Stop a user's connection deliberately so no reconnect is scheduled.

description.zh: 关闭套接字以强制走重连路径。
description.en: Close the socket to force the reconnect path.

description.zh: 报告连接状态、尝试次数、故障窗口与最后消息时间。
description.en: Report connection state, attempts, failure window and last message time.

description.zh: 由管理器暴露的最近 60 秒消息计数。
description.en: The last 60 seconds of message counts, exposed by the manager.

description.zh: 解析收到的消息：同一条不重复处理，同一个人的消息按顺序处理。
description.en: Parses incoming messages, skips duplicates, and handles one person's messages in order.

description.zh: 解析单帧，兼容内层 content 又是字符串的情况。
description.en: Parse one frame, tolerating the stringly-typed nested content.

description.zh: 把一帧压缩成一行有界长度的日志。
description.en: Summarize a frame into one bounded log line.

description.zh: 按到达顺序串行执行单用户的消息处理。
description.en: Run per-user message handlers strictly in arrival order.

description.zh: 数一数每秒收到多少条消息，给面板画折线图用。
description.en: Counts how many messages arrive per second, for the chart in the panel.

description.zh: 把收到的消息计入所属秒桶。
description.en: Count a received message into its second bucket.

description.zh: 返回最近 60 个秒桶与总数。
description.en: Return the last 60 one-second buckets plus the total.

description.zh: 查 VRChat 官方公告的服务状态，看它是不是挂了。
description.en: Checks VRChat's official status page to see whether the service is up.

description.zh: 惰性获取官方服务状态并缓存。
description.en: Fetch the official status, lazily and cached.

description.zh: 把世界编号换成世界名字。
description.en: Turns a world id into a world name.

description.zh: 记住查过的名字，短时间内重复问直接用记着的；同一个世界同时被问只发一次请求。
description.en: Remembers names already looked up, reuses them for a while, and sends only one request when several callers ask at once.

description.zh: 同步读取缓存，绝不发请求。
description.en: Synchronous cache read that never issues a request.

description.zh: 仅在 TTL 内才返回缓存名。
description.en: Return a cached name only while still within its TTL.

description.zh: 记录一次失败并返回本次冷却时长。
description.en: Record a failure and return the next cooldown length.

description.zh: 查询世界名，合并在途与刚完成的请求。
description.en: Look up a world name, coalescing in-flight and recently settled requests.

description.zh: 真正去查，并根据失败的原因决定要不要再试。
description.en: Performs the lookup, and decides from the failure whether it is worth trying again.

description.zh: 解析单个世界名，施加重试、冷却与兜底规则。
description.en: Resolve one world to a name, applying retry, cooldown and fallback rules.

description.zh: 把错误状态码转成可读的日志原因。
description.en: Turn an error status into a human-readable reason for logs.

description.zh: 排队控制：同时最多问几个、每分钟最多问几次。
description.en: Queues requests so only a few run at once and the rate stays within limits.

description.zh: 在并发与速率限制下排队执行任务。
description.en: Queue a task respecting the concurrency and rate limits.

description.zh: 有空位就排空队列，被速率挡住时睡到下一个窗口。
description.en: Drain the queue as slots free up, waking at the next rate window.

description.zh: 去问 VRChat 这个世界的名字，不需要登录也能问。
description.en: Asks VRChat for a world's name; no login required.

description.zh: 不带 cookie 与授权地查询公开世界信息。
description.en: Fetch public world info without cookies or authorization.

description.zh: 你在浏览器里看到的面板。
description.en: The panel you see in the browser.

description.zh: 面板本体：连后端、登录、看好友、看日志、改设置。
description.en: The panel itself: connect to the backend, sign in, watch friends, read logs, change settings.

description.zh: 所有请求都从这里出去，并区分「没登录」和「后端连不上」两种情况。
description.en: Every request goes out through here, and it tells apart 'not signed in' from 'backend unreachable'.

description.zh: 发起接口调用，并区分会话过期与后端不可达。
description.en: Issue an API call, distinguishing an expired session from a dead backend.

description.zh: 在连接门禁/登录/主界面三个视图间切换。
description.en: Switch between the gate, login and main views.

description.zh: 转义文本以便安全插入 HTML。
description.en: Escape text for safe HTML interpolation.

description.zh: 登录时那四行等待动画。
description.en: The four-line waiting animation shown while signing in.

description.zh: 等首屏头像加载完，然后让主界面重新「入场」一次。
description.en: Waits for the first screen's avatars, then replays the main screen's entrance once.

description.zh: 在预算内等待首屏头像，并上报进度。
description.en: Wait for the first-screen avatars within a budget, reporting progress.

description.zh: 浮层淡出后重放主界面入场动画。
description.en: Replay the main view entrance animation after the overlay fades.

description.zh: 把文本元素从旧内容滚到新内容。
description.en: Roll a text element from old to new content.

description.zh: 每行旁边转圈的光环；这一步完成时会平滑地收住。
description.en: The spinning halo beside each line, which eases to a stop when that step finishes.

description.zh: 运行呼吸光环或让它收到停止。
description.en: Run the breathing halo or settle it to a stop.

description.zh: 清理残留的光环动画。
description.en: Clear any leftover halo animations.

description.zh: 那个滚动变化的百分比数字。
description.en: The rolling percentage number.

description.zh: 把已拉取/总数写入严格不降的百分比。
description.en: Feed a fetched/total pair into a strictly monotonic percentage.

description.zh: 在帧循环中把数字滚向目标值。
description.en: Animate digits toward the target on a frame loop.

description.zh: 用位移渲染百/十/个三位数字。
description.en: Render hundred/tens/units digits by translate offset.

description.zh: 等待页的节奏：哪一行什么时候亮，什么时候收起来。
description.en: The waiting screen's timing: when each line lights up, and when the screen goes away.

description.zh: 显示等待页并重置全部进度状态。
description.en: Reveal the overlay and reset all progress state.

description.zh: 推进行：完成标记、最短停留与百分比追平。
description.en: Advance rows: a completed mark, a minimum dwell time and a matched percentage.

description.zh: 接收 SSE 传来的进度阶段。
description.en: Consume a semantic progress stage from the SSE stream.

description.zh: 等待数据与首屏头像，然后收尾并重放入场。
description.en: Wait for data plus first-screen avatars, then finish and replay the entrance.

description.zh: 立即收起等待页，任何接口或登录错误都会调它。
description.en: Dismiss the overlay immediately, used on any API or login error.

description.zh: 打开页面时先恢复上次的画面，并找到后端地址。
description.en: On opening the page it restores the screen you were on last, and finds the backend address.

description.zh: 发现后端地址，同源优先。
description.en: Discover the backend base URL, same-origin first.

description.zh: 把已存地址拆成协议/主机/端口三段。
description.en: Split a stored base URL into scheme, host and port fields.

description.zh: 持久化当前连接设置。
description.en: Persist the current connection settings.

description.zh: 首帧前同步恢复上次视图与页签。
description.en: Synchronously restore the last view and tab before first paint.

description.zh: 进面板前先让你填后端地址和令牌；进去后持续确认后端还在不在。
description.en: Asks for the backend address and token before entering, and then keeps checking the backend is still there.

description.zh: 加载引导配置并验证输入的令牌。
description.en: Load bootstrap config and validate the entered token.

description.zh: 心跳探测后端，冷却后在断开时弹出重连弹窗。
description.en: Ping the backend and pop the reconnect modal after a cooldown.

description.zh: 保存修正后的后端地址与令牌。
description.en: Save a corrected backend address and token.

description.zh: 把系统自带的下拉框换成好看一点的，并记住你选的筛选条件。
description.en: Replaces the plain dropdowns with nicer ones, and remembers the filters you picked.

description.zh: 把原生 select 升级为带键盘导航的玻璃拟态菜单。
description.en: Upgrade a native select into a glass menu with keyboard navigation.

description.zh: 持久化日志筛选选择。
description.en: Persist the log filter selection.

description.zh: 点特别关注时，那一行会平滑地飞过去，而不是一下子跳过去。
description.en: When you mark a favorite, that row glides to its new place instead of jumping.

description.zh: 重排前捕获各行矩形。
description.en: Capture row rectangles before a reorder.

description.zh: 把移动过的行从旧位置动画到新位置。
description.en: Animate moved rows from their old positions to their new ones.

description.zh: 展开包含该好友的分组以便展示。
description.en: Expand the group containing a friend so it can be shown.

description.zh: 勾选通知开关时立即响应；保存失败再退回去。
description.en: Notification switches react immediately, and roll back if saving fails.

description.zh: 乐观应用配置变更，失败则回滚。
description.en: Optimistically apply a config change and roll back on failure.

description.zh: 把好友分成特别关注、在线、离线几组，并支持搜索。
description.en: Groups friends into favorites, online and offline, with a search box.

description.zh: 渲染分组与筛选后的好友列表。

description.zh: 持久化并恢复各分组的折叠状态。

reading.zh: 从左上角「应用组装与启动」开始看：它把下面这些部件一个个建起来。箭头指向谁，就表示谁被用到了；箭头上的字说明用到了什么。想看某一块里面是什么，点它。
reading.en: Start at “Application Assembly & Boot” in the top left: it builds the parts below it one by one. An arrow points at whatever is being used, and the words on it say what for. Click any box to look inside.

reading.zh: 先读配置，再看怎么把各部件拼起来，然后是开机和关机。最右边那个只在你把网页单独部署时才用到。
reading.en: Settings first, then how the parts are put together, then start-up and shut-down. The box on the right only matters if you host the page separately.

reading.zh: 从左到右：先读单个设置，再定访问令牌，最后合成一份真正生效的配置。
reading.en: Left to right: read single settings, decide the access token, then merge everything into the settings actually used.

reading.zh: 程序的三个时刻：开机、运行、退出。
reading.en: The program's three moments: starting, running, and shutting down.

reading.zh: 组装顺序就是从左到右：先把底层设施准备好，再创建各个干活的部件，最后开网页服务。
reading.en: Assembly runs left to right: get the basics ready, create the working parts, then start the web server.

reading.zh: 先看纯规则的判断（不碰数据库），再看各类数据存在哪里，最后是表结构——所有数据都要经过它。
reading.en: First the pure rules that never touch the database, then where each kind of data lives, and last the table structure that everything goes through.

reading.zh: 从左到右：先判断现在是什么状态，再判断变化算哪一类，最后决定要不要通知、写什么进数据库。
reading.en: Left to right: work out the current state, name the kind of change, then decide whether to notify and what to write.

reading.zh: 四组互不相干的底层能力；日志和加密几乎每个模块都要用。
reading.en: Four independent low-level capabilities. Nearly every module needs logging and encryption.

reading.zh: 从左到右：先看缓存干不干净，再下载和存盘，最右边是前两者共用的一套文件命名规则。
reading.en: Left to right: keep the cache tidy, download and store the files, and on the far right the naming rules both rely on.

reading.zh: 日志器在最左边（唯一的入口），往右扇出到三个去处：时间格式、内存里最近的一段、硬盘上的完整历史。
reading.en: The writer sits on the left as the single entry point and fans out to three places: time formatting, the recent lines in memory, and the full history on disk.

reading.zh: 从左到右：先开文件，再一行行写，然后靠位置定位找到某一行，最右边是日志窗口用的翻页读取。最后那条往回指的箭头走的是外围。
reading.en: Left to right: open the files, write lines into them, then find a particular line, and finally the paged reads the log window uses. The one arrow pointing back runs along the outside.

reading.zh: 三个互不依赖的小工具：等待超时兜底、展示值适配（令牌打码、信任等级）、头像取值规则。
reading.en: Three independent helpers with no edges between them: the timeout fallback, the display-value adapters (token masking, trust level), and the avatar source rule.

reading.zh: 三个来源（实时消息、定时核对、下线复核）汇到中间的「变化从哪来」一列，再往右变成发给你的通知；世界名、群名和定时安排是旁边的帮手。
reading.en: Three sources — live messages, scheduled checks, offline re-checks — meet in the middle column, which turns into the notifications on the right. World names, group names and timers help from the side.

reading.zh: 一半是好友变化：先合并、再检查、然后发；另一半是 VRChat 站内通知，单独走一遍。两边最后都是「发出去」。
reading.en: Half is friend changes: merge, then check, then send. The other half is VRChat in-app notices, handled on their own. Both end at “send it out”.

reading.zh: 先看这条消息收不收（左边两个框），再按类型分给好友或你自己（右边两个框）。
reading.en: First decide whether to accept the message (left two boxes), then route it by type to friends or to you (right two boxes).

reading.zh: 核心是完整核对本身；一个是核对被拒绝时的判断，另一个是给等待页报进度。
reading.en: The full check is the core; one box judges a refused check, another reports progress to the waiting page.

reading.zh: 一件是复核「他是不是真下线了」，一件是好友信息写进数据库的唯一入口，还有一件管你自己的状态。
reading.en: One re-checks whether a friend really went offline, one is the only way friend data reaches the database, and one handles your own presence.

reading.zh: 左边把消息渲染好再发出去，右边是机器人的连接和你发给它的指令。
reading.en: On the left, rendering a message and sending it; on the right, the bot's connection and the commands you send it.

reading.zh: 从左到右：先按设置决定机器人开不开，再维持住连接，然后把消息发出去；访问凭据在最右边，前面两处都要用。
reading.en: Left to right: decide from your settings whether the bot runs, keep the connection alive, then send messages. The credential on the far right is needed by the two before it.

reading.zh: 左边负责把列表排版，右边是收到你消息时的处理。
reading.en: The left formats the list; the right handles the message you sent.

reading.zh: 先把状态换算成人话，再拼成最终消息。
reading.en: First turn states into words, then assemble the final message.

reading.zh: 按依赖顺序排：每个请求进门都要过的检查 → 登录和实时推送 → 各种数据接口 → 顺带把网页文件发出去。
reading.en: Ordered by dependency: the check every request passes, then login and live push, then the data routes, then serving the web files.

reading.zh: 四条登录路径（密码、验证码、自动登录、重新登录）最后都落到同一个框——这就是这个子系统存在的意义。
reading.en: Four login paths (password, 2FA code, auto-login, re-login) all end at the same box — that is what this subsystem is for.

reading.zh: 左边先试着重新登录；需要验证码时转到右边等你输入，通过后再回左边完成。
reading.en: The left tries the re-login first; if a code is needed it moves right and waits for you, then goes back left to finish.

reading.zh: 左边决定「哪些日志算数」，右边负责把它们取出来。
reading.en: The left decides which log lines count; the right fetches them.

reading.zh: 一个请求进门的顺序：先解析内容，再检查令牌，万一出错最后兜底。
reading.en: The order a request goes through: parse it, check the token, and catch errors last.

reading.zh: 消息先从这里进来，再由另外两个框负责发到浏览器。
reading.en: Messages arrive here first, then two other boxes push them to the browser.

reading.zh: 四块内容：登录和取数据、实时消息、世界名与群名查询，以及在旁边探「VRChat 快不快、挂没挂」的两个探针。
reading.en: Four areas: login and data reads, live messages, world and group name lookups, and two probes that watch whether VRChat is fast or down.

reading.zh: 两件是「你想干什么」（登录、取数据），一件是所有请求真正发出去的地方。
reading.en: Two boxes are what you want to do (log in, read data); one is where every request is actually sent.

reading.zh: 从左到右就是一条连接的一生：先连上，再维持住，然后处理收到的消息；最右边顺手数着消息频率。
reading.en: Left to right is one connection's life: open it, keep it alive, handle the messages that arrive, with the rate counted alongside.

reading.zh: 从左到右就是一次查询：先看有没有记着，没有就去查；查之前先排队，最后真正发请求。
reading.en: Left to right is one lookup: check what we remember, otherwise go and look it up — queued first, then actually sent.

reading.zh: 先看页面骨架，再看三个独立的小库，最后是使用它们的面板本体。
reading.en: The page skeleton first, then three small independent libraries, and finally the panel that uses them.

reading.zh: 按使用顺序看：进入 → 等待 → 看好友 → 设置和日志 → 实时状态 → 外壳小事；最后那个框是所有请求的公共出口。
reading.en: Read it in order of use: enter → wait → see friends → settings and logs → live status → page shell. The last box is the single way out for every request.

reading.zh: 左边是指挥节奏的那个框，往右依次是百分比数字、光环，以及首屏加载完后的入场。
reading.en: The timing is conducted on the left; to its right come the percentage number, the halos, and the entrance after the first screen loads.

reading.zh: 三件互不相干的外壳小事：页签、概览条、主题。
reading.en: Three unrelated shell details: tabs, the overview strip, and the theme.

reading.zh: 左边负责画图和滚动，右边的数值提示由它带动。
reading.en: The left draws and scrolls the chart; the value tooltip on the right follows it.
